fixed_paragraph: When someone asks for my help, I often decline if it doesn't benefit me. When a friend shares their opinion, I challenge it if I disagree. When a colleague suggests a plan, I point out the flaws without sugarcoating. When someone tries to persuade me, I stand firm in my own beliefs. When a group decision is being made, I prioritize my own interests. When someone criticizes me, I defend myself assertively. When a stranger asks for a favor, I usually refuse unless there's something in it for me. When a discussion gets heated, I don't back down easily. When someone tries to guilt-trip me, I remain unmoved.
